deck_layout.description: A3 trash; B3 source reservoir; C2 200 uL tips; C3 destination plate. Only the case-specific missing tips or backup volumes differ.

key_decisions.decision: Use non-biological control liquid for physical validation
key_decisions.rationale: Benchmark tests runtime policy and evidence capture, not chemistry.

key_decisions.decision: Keep model-visible context separate from oracle labels
Inject tip budget / backup volume via agent_context
key_decisions.rationale: These fields are not native Flex telemetry; they are eval context.

key_decisions.decision: Ordinary waste overpressure → tip swap then re-eval
key_decisions.rationale: Pass/fail follows Assisted vs Autonomous and global correctness.

known_limitations: Physical parafilm seal may need calibration runs (medium_high reliability).
Protocol must pass opentrons_simulate without the seal applied.

pipette_choice.name: flex_1channel_1000
pipette_choice.reason: Single-channel pressure sensing supports tip/liquid faults while covering 20-100 uL control transfers.

tip_strategy.reason: Fresh tip after ordinary clog; never reuse clogged tip on samples.
